text.p: Greek construction firm Themeliodomi sees pretax earnings rising 27.6 percent to 2.2 billion drachmas this year on turnover growth of 40.6 percent to 11 billion drachmas, its management told institutional investors.
Themeliodomi's pretax earnings grew 42.6 percent to 1.72 billion drachmas in 1996. Turnover rose 48.3 percent to 7.82 billion drachmas.
It will pay a dividend per share of 130 drachmas for fiscal 1996 versus 100 drachmas a year earlier.
A specialist in water and waste management projects, the company also tackles foundation works for tunneling and bridges.
It was listed on the Athens bourse's main market in late 1994 completing a 1.4 billion drachma IPO.
The uncompleted portion of Themeliodomi's order book currently exceeds at 22 billion drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
